battle.name: 呂明星起義
battle.brief: 大業九年十月，隋煬帝北巡博陵之際，賊帥呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，武賲郎將費青奴以精騎擊破之，明星本人被斬。卡面的羅馬弩砲在隋代中國並無對應器械，這場戰役留下的是另一套武器系統：明甲馬槊的近衛騎兵，對上以鄉里部曲組成、只有數千之眾的起義軍。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 呂明星起義是隋大業九年（613年）十月發生在東郡的一次短促交鋒。交戰的一方是隋朝官軍：史籍只記錄中央近衛的一支精騎，由武賲郎將費青奴率領，趕到東郡城下解圍；東郡（河南郡，治所在洛陽）本身的郡兵與州府衛士是否出城接戰，記載未及。發出軍令的隋煬帝當時正在河北博陵巡幸，洛陽的東都留守府以越王侗留守、民部尚書樊子蓋輔佐策應。另一方是呂明星率領的起義眾，人數記為「數千」，成員多為郡縣鄉里的壯丁、逃散兵卒與亡命之徒，聚集於山東、河南、河北交界地帶，以「賊帥」自居。呂明星並非孤例：同年齊人孟讓、王薄等聚眾十餘萬據長白山，清河張金稱眾數萬，渤海格謙自號燕王、孫宣雅自號齊王各眾十萬，吳郡朱燮與管崇推劉元進為天子，扶風向海明稱帝建元白烏，六月黎陽楊玄感又以「誅無道」為名起兵。呂明星之舉夾在這一大片起義之中，規模中等，文字記載卻最少。
countriesEn: The Lü Mingbao rising was a brief clash fought at Dong Commandery in the tenth month of the ninth year of the Daye era, 613. One side was the Sui government force: the historical records mention only a detachment of elite imperial guard cavalry, led by the wubei langjiang Fei Qingnu, which reached the walls of Dong Commandery and lifted the siege; whether the local county militia and the prefectural guards of Dong Commandery itself came out to fight is not recorded. The Sui emperor who issued the order was at that moment on a progress through Boling in Hebei, while in Luoyang the regency of the Eastern Capital was held by Prince of Yue Yang Tong, assisted by the Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai. The other side was the rebel band led by Lü Mingbao, recorded as several thousand men, recruited mostly from the able-bodied men of the local districts, soldiers who had dispersed from the armies, and men living outside the law, gathered along the borderlands of Shandong, Henan and Hebei and styling themselves as a band of rebels. Lü Mingbao was no isolated case: in the same year Meng Rang and Wang Bo of Qi gathered more than a hundred thousand men and occupied Mount Changbai, Zhang Jincheng of Qinghe had several tens of thousands, Ge Qian of Bohai proclaimed himself King of Yan and Sun Xuanya proclaimed himself King of Qi with one hundred thousand men each, Zhu Xie and Guan Chong of Wu Commandery raised Liu Yuanjin to be emperor, and Xiang Haiming of Fufeng proclaimed himself emperor with the era title Baiwu; in the sixth month Yang Xuangan of Liyang rose claiming to punish the tyrant. Lü Mingbao's rising sits inside that broad wave, of middling size, and it is the one left with the fewest words in writing.
people: 呂明星是這場起義的首領，籍貫與出身在正史中沒有留下記載，只以「賊帥」之名出現；他率領數千眾包圍東郡，是隋煬帝大業九年十月最迫近洛陽的一次軍事行動，事後兵敗被斬。率軍解圍的是費青奴，《隋書·煬帝紀》記他為武賲郎將，《資治通鑑》卷一百八十二則作虎賁郎將，兩書對同一武職的稱呼略有出入；他在隋代武官序列中位在將軍之下、校尉之上，得以率一部出動。《隋書》記他「擊斬」明星本人，《通鑑》只作「擊破之」，兩者都把結果壓在一句話裡。隋煬帝楊廣是這場衝突的最終決策者：九月甲午車駕至上谷，因供費不給免了太守虞荷等官；閏月己巳幸博陵；十月丁丑東郡被圍，八日後的乙酉便下詔改博陵為高陽郡、赦境內死罪已下、給復一年，並以納言蘇威為開府儀同三司。樊子蓋以民部尚書身份佐越王侗留守東都，收拾楊玄感留下的文簿，又把李密等十餘人押送行在，途中李密一夥在魏郡石梁驛乘醉穿牆脫逃，兩年後成了瓦崗寨的核心。同一條防線上還有張須陀這位齊郡丞，他以郡兵破王薄於泰山下、臨邑、章丘、歷城，旗下十四歲的歷城少年羅士信持槊衝陣；呂明星敗後，魚俱羅與吐萬緒奉命討劉元進，卻連年不能剋。
peopleEn: Lü Mingbao was the leader of this rising. His native place and his background leave no trace in the official histories; he appears only under the name of a rebel commander. He led several thousand men to surround Dong Commandery, the closest approach to Luoyang by any military action in the tenth month of Daye 9, and was killed when his force was defeated. The officer who lifted the siege was Fei Qingnu. The Book of Sui, Annals of Yangdi, records him as a wubei langjiang, while the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, juan 182, writes tiger guard langjiang; the two texts differ slightly in the title they give the same military post. In the Sui ranking of military officers the langjiang stood below the general and above the commandant, and was therefore able to lead a detachment on his own. The Book of Sui says he struck Lü Mingbao down, the Mirror says only that he broke the rebels; both compress the result into a single sentence. Sui Yangdi, Emperor Yang, was the final decision-maker in this affair. On the jiawu day of the ninth month his carriage reached Shanggu, and because supplies had failed he dismissed the administrator Yu He and other officials; on the jisi day of the intercalary month he reached Boling; on the dingchou day of the tenth month Dong Commandery was besieged, and eight days later, on the yiyou day, he issued an edict renaming Boling Commandery as Gaoyang Commandery, pardoning all crimes punishable by death in that territory, granting a year's exemption from taxes, and raising Su Wei, formerly of the office of censor in chief, to the rank of Grand Master of the Palace with the Three Excellencies. Fan Zigai, as Minister of Revenue, assisted Prince of Yue Yang Tong in holding the Eastern Capital, collected the papers left behind by Yang Xuangan and escorted Li Mi and a dozen others to the imperial camp; on the way, at Shiliang Station in Wei Commandery, Li Mi and his companions escaped through a wall while the escort was drunk, and two years later he became the core of the Wagang stronghold. On the same defensive front stood Zhang Xutuo, governor of Qi Commandery, who used county militia to defeat Wang Bo below Mount Tai and again at Linyi, Zhangqiu and Licheng, with the fourteen-year-old boy from Licheng, Luo Shixin, charging the line with a long spear. After Lü Mingbao's defeat, Yu Juluo and Tu Wanxu were ordered against Liu Yuanjin, and could not take him for years.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，是前50年前後羅馬共和國的扭力弩砲，一發一具箭，靠扭力臂把沉重的箭矢送出去，羅馬人用它拆掉了希臘的城牆與城邦體系。隋代中國沒有這種器械的任何記載：螺式扭力弩砲需要成熟的青銅與鐵件加工工坊和成建制的弩砲隊，東郡之圍的兩條史文對攻城器械一字未提，沒有雲梯、沒有撞車、也沒有投石機的記錄。現場能落實的只有兩套東西：官軍方面是虎賲、武賲這類近衛重騎，配明光甲、馬槊、長刀與弓箭，同年在濰水戰場上，十四歲的羅士信就是手持槊躍入賊陣，取人首級掛於槊上；再往外是郡兵與步卒沿用漢晉以來的弩、弓、矛。起義眾一方用什麼器械，記載同樣沒有留下。可以確定的只是量級：數千對一部精騎，重裝備在場的是官軍一方，起義一方是鄉里部曲式的雜兵。弩砲那種能改變城防規則的攻城器械，在中國要到唐代兵書裏才有床弩、擲車一類的記載，中間相隔數百年間，攻城靠的仍是塹壕、穴地與雲梯這些老法子。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman Scorpio, a torsion-powered artillery piece of the Roman Republic around 50 BC: it shoots one heavy bolt at a time, driven by the stored torsion of twisted skeins, and the Romans used it to break down Greek city walls and, with them, the Greek system of city-states. There is not a single record of anything like it in Sui China. A torsion catapult of that type demanded mature bronze and iron working and a formed catapult corps, and the two passages that describe the siege of Dong Commandery say not one word about siege equipment: no ladders, no battering rams, no stone-throwers. Only two sets of gear can actually be pinned down for the field. On the government side were the heavy guard cavalry of the tiger and martial guards, in bright scale armour with long cavalry lances, sabres and bows; on the battlefield by the Wei river in the same year, the fourteen-year-old Luo Shixin went into the rebel line holding a lance, cutting down men and hanging a severed head on its point. Beyond them, the county militia and the infantry carried on with the crossbows, bows and spears used since the Han and Jin. What the rebels used is likewise not recorded. What can be settled is the scale: several thousand against one detachment of elite cavalry, the heavy equipment on the government's side, the rebels in the manner of village bands armed with a mixture. Artillery of the kind that could rewrite the rules of fortification would not appear in Chinese sources until the military manuals of the Tang, with the repeating crossbow and the traction trebuchet; across the several centuries between, the taking of a Chinese walled town still relied on ditches, mining under the foundation and scaling ladders.
tactics: 關於這場戰役的戰術，兩部史書各留一句話，可據以推斷的空間有限。起義方是「率眾數千圍東郡」，圍的是河南郡的治所洛陽；起義眾沒有留下壕溝、拒馬、雲梯、撞車或火攻的任何記載，因此無法斷定他們是打算長期困城，還是想封鎖道路、脅迫郡府開城。數千之眾圍一座有堅固城防、且握有精兵的州府城，器械不足的話，多半只能做到封鎖與擾動，攻破則難。官軍一方的做法清楚得多：費青奴率近衛精騎自外部趕到，選擇攻擊的正是圍城的這批人，隋書作「擊斬之」，通鑑作「擊破之」，都指一次短促的反擊就把圍解了，而不是長期圍困打援。雙方的差別在配給與指揮：起義眾分散在鄉里，靠地方供給維持數千人的屯駐本已吃力，兵一旦潰散就沒有第二道防線；精騎則可以不打攻城器械，只求在城外找到對方聚集的一點，打完即走。放在613年的全局看，隋廷真正站得住的只有一種打法：郡丞張須陀以郡兵、簡精兵倍道進擊，在泰山下、臨邑、章丘、歷城連破王薄，斬數萬級；同一份通鑑卻說郡縣吏與賊戰多望風沮敗。同月東郡被圍、八日後改博陵為高陽郡並赦罪給復、十二月車裂楊玄感黨羽十餘人並焚其屍，一剛一柔，正是鎮壓與安撫同時出手的樣子。
tacticsEn: As for tactics, each of the two histories preserves a single sentence, and the room for inference is narrow. The rebel side is recorded as leading several thousand men to surround Dong Commandery, meaning the seat of Henan Commandery, Luoyang. The rebels left no trace of a ditch, a cheval de frise, a scaling ladder, a battering ram or a fire attack, so it is impossible to determine whether they meant to hold the city in a prolonged siege or simply to close the roads and force the prefectural authorities to open the gates. Several thousand men around a firmly walled prefectural seat that still had elite troops to hand could, with inadequate equipment, achieve blockade and harassment but not a breach. The government's side is far clearer: Fei Qingnu brought the guard cavalry in from outside, and the men he chose to attack were precisely the ones besieging the city. The Book of Sui says he struck Lü Mingbao down, the Mirror says he broke them; both describe a single short counterstroke that lifted the siege, rather than a long war of attrition against a relief army. The difference between the sides lay in supply and command. The rebels were dispersed across the villages, and holding several thousand men in place was already a strain on local provisioning; once their line broke there was no second line behind it. The cavalry, by contrast, had no siege equipment to deal with and only needed to find the point where the enemy massed outside the walls, and then leave. Set against the wider year 613, the Sui court really had only one method that held: the governor of Qi, Zhang Xutuo, took county militia and a picked force, advanced by forced marches, and beat Wang Bo repeatedly below Mount Tai and at Linyi, Zhangqiu and Licheng, cutting down tens of thousands; and yet the same Mirror records that district officers and their men lost heart at the first sign of the rebels. The siege of Dong Commandery, the renaming of Boling as Gaoyang with pardons and tax remission eight days later, and the wheeling of the ten or more followers of Yang Xuangan with their bodies burned in December of the same year, all show coercion and conciliation applied at the same time.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但每一個都有出處。大業九年即613年；十月丁丑賊帥呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，同月乙酉改博陵為高陽郡，兩個日子相隔八日。起義眾的規模只有「數千」一個數字，是隋書唯一留下的兵力記載；通鑑只說「圍東郡」，連人數都不提。官軍投入的兵力史無一字，只知主將的品秩為武賲郎將，通鑑作虎賁郎將。同年可作對照的數字很多：九月乙卯東海民彭孝才起為盜有眾數萬；齊人孟讓、王薄等眾十餘萬據長白山，張金稱眾數萬，格謙、孫宣雅各眾十萬；張須陀在歷城一役斬數萬級、前後獲賊輜重不可勝計。事件本身沒有留下戰損、行程或攻城時間的數字。距離方面，隋書記煬帝九月甲午車駕至上谷、閏月己巳幸博陵，從博陵南下到東郡要經河間、黎陽再渡大河，官方文獻沒有留下里數，只有官軍騎兵能在一段時間內趕到城下這一事實可作時限的反推。此外，十一月己酉右候衛將軍馮孝慈討張金稱於清河反為所敗而死，十二月車裂玄感弟積善及黨與十餘人仍焚而揚之，可見同年反叛與反制同時密集發生。記載有限之處，寧可留白，不宜補造。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, but each has a source. The ninth year of Daye is 613. On the dingchou day of the tenth month the rebel commander Lü Mingbao led several thousand men to surround Dong Commandery, and on the yiyou day of the same month Boling was renamed Gaoyang Commandery; the two dates are eight days apart. The size of the rebel force has only one figure, several thousand, and it is the single strength figure the Book of Sui preserves. The Mirror says only that he surrounded Dong Commandery and does not even give a headcount. The strength the government committed is not recorded at all; only the rank of the commander survives, langjiang of the martial or tiger guards, depending on which text one follows. The same year supplies many figures for comparison: on the yimao day of the ninth month Peng Xiaocai of the East Sea rose as a bandit with several tens of thousands; Meng Rang and Wang Bo of Qi held more than a hundred thousand men on Mount Changbai; Zhang Jincheng had tens of thousands; Ge Qian and Sun Xuanya had one hundred thousand each; and in the fighting at Licheng Zhang Xutuo cut down tens of thousands and took an immense quantity of booty. The event itself leaves no figures for losses, distances marched or the length of the siege. On distance, the Book of Sui records the emperor's carriage reaching Shanggu on the jiawu day of the ninth month and Boling on the jisi day of the intercalary month; the road south from Boling to Dong Commandery ran through Hanjian and Liyang and then across the great river, and no official document preserves a figure in li, only the fact that government cavalry reached the walls within a certain span of time, which can be reasoned backwards as a rough limit. Beyond that, on the jiyou day of the eleventh month the Right Commandant-General Feng Xiaoci was defeated and killed at Qinghe while fighting Zhang Jincheng, and in December Yang Xuangan's brother Jishan and a dozen others were broken on the wheel and their bodies burned and scattered, showing how densely rebellion and repression were interleaved that year. Where the record is thin it is better to leave a blank than to invent a number.
cause: 呂明星起義的直接起因在史料中沒有明文，只能從大業九年的整體局勢推。隋自大業八年冬起連續征高句麗，兵役、徭役與糧秣轉運的負擔主要壓在山東與河北，隋書帝紀記車駕至上谷時「供費不給」，當場免了太守虞荷等官；同月東陽人李三兒、向但子舉兵眾至萬餘，可見民間已因費用與調發而沸騰。通鑑直言「天下承平日久，人不習兵，郡縣吏每與賊戰，望風沮敗」，說明承平數十年後地方已無可用之兵，郡縣的守備能力在叛軍面前一觸即潰。六月楊玄感在黎陽起兵，閉城大索男夫，取帆布為牟、甲，署官屬皆准開皇之舊，移書傍郡以討護兒為名令各郡發兵會於倉所，等於把朝廷在糧道與軍令上的破口公開攤開，隋廷隨後以車裂與焚揚回應，李密一夥正是在押解途中脫逃。地方官員在此局勢下被大量追究與撤換，皇帝本人又不斷在郡縣巡行，停留於上谷與博陵。呂明星在這樣的環境下聚眾數千、指向東郡，與同年其他起義者並非孤立事件；至於他是何人、何時何地首義，兩部史書都沒有留下記載。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of Lü Mingbao's rising is not stated in the sources and can only be inferred from the general situation of the ninth year of Daye. Beginning in the winter of the eighth year of Daye the Sui had campaigned against Goguryeo in succession, and the weight of levies, corvée labour and the transport of grain and provisions fell mainly on Shandong and Hebei. The Book of Sui records that when the imperial carriage reached Shanggu the supplies were insufficient, and Yu He and other district administrators were dismissed on the spot; in the same month Li San'er and Xiang Danzhi of Dongyang rose with more than ten thousand men, showing that the countryside had begun to seethe over the cost of requisitions. The Mirror puts it plainly: for a long time the realm had enjoyed peace, men had not practised arms, and whenever district officers fought the rebels their hearts failed at the first sign of them. Local defence had collapsed on contact. In the sixth month Yang Xuangan rose at Liyang, closed the city, seized all adult males, took sailcloth for mooring stakes and armour, and set up officials and regulations after the fashion of the Kaihuang era, while sending letters to the neighbouring districts under the pretext of punishing Lai'er and calling on each to send troops to the granary; this exposed in the open the weakness of the court in supply lines and command, and the Sui answered with the wheel and the burning of corpses, Li Mi's band escaping while under escort. District officials were now repeatedly called to account and removed, and the emperor himself went on progress through the districts, halting at Shanggu and Boling. Lü Mingbao gathering several thousand men and turning them towards Dong Commandery in such a setting was not an isolated act, and no separate explanation is needed to make it stand beside the other risings of that year. As for who he was, and where and when he first took up arms, neither history records.
impact: 呂明星起義的結局本身不足以改變大業九年的走向，但它在兩個方向上留下了痕跡。第一是對隋廷的應變機制：東郡是河南郡治所、隋的東都所在，數千起義眾一度把郡城圍住，說明中央近衛之外，地方郡兵在613年已不能獨力守土，能靠的只有像費青奴那樣的精騎奔襲，以及像張須陀那樣熟悉地形的郡兵。隋廷此後的處置是武力鎮壓與恩赦安撫並用：十月乙酉改博陵為高陽郡、赦死罪、給復一年，十二月又車裂楊積善等十餘人並焚揚其屍。第二是對後續亂局的連鎖：呂明星敗後不到一年，劉元進在吳郡被推為天子，吐萬緒與魚俱羅討之連年不能剋；向海明在扶風建元白烏；王薄、孟讓在長白山聚眾十餘萬，直到張須陀在山東次第掃平，東部的亂局才逐步收束。613年這批起義的殘部、散兵與流民，兩年後成了瓦崗軍的兵源，而李密本人正是這年從楊玄感軍中脫逃的人。對後世史家而言，本事件留下的最大教訓反而是文獻的稀薄：《隋書》只一句、《通鑑》只一句，攻城器械、糧秣、戰損、編制全部無記，一場逼近都城的戰鬥在正史裡幾乎無名。
impactEn: The outcome of Lü Mingbao's rising by itself was not enough to change the course of the ninth year of Daye, but it left traces in two directions. The first concerns the Sui court's mechanism for meeting emergencies. Dong Commandery was the seat of Henan Commandery and of the Eastern Capital, and several thousand rebels surrounded the city for a time. This showed that apart from the central guard, the county militia of 613 could no longer hold ground on its own; what could be relied on was a dash of elite cavalry like Fei Qingnu's and militia that knew the ground like Zhang Xutuo's. From then on the court's method combined armed suppression with pardon and reassurance: on the yiyou day of the tenth month Boling was renamed Gaoyang, crimes punishable by death were pardoned and a year's remission granted, and in December Jishan and a dozen others were broken on the wheel and their bodies burned and scattered. The second direction is the chain reaction in the later disorder. Within less than a year of Lü Mingbao's defeat Liu Yuanjin was raised to emperor at Wu Commandery, and Yu Juluo and Tu Wanxu could not take him for years; Xiang Haiming proclaimed the era Baiwu in Fufeng; Wang Bo and Meng Rang held more than a hundred thousand men on Mount Changbai, and it was only as Zhang Xutuo cleared Shandong in turn that disorder in the east gradually closed. The remnants of the 613 risings, scattered soldiers and refugees, became two years later the manpower of the Wagang army, and Li Mi himself was the man who had escaped from Yang Xuangan's camp that year. For later historians the greatest lesson of the episode is the thinness of the record: one sentence in the Book of Sui, one in the Mirror, with nothing on siege equipment, provisions, losses or order of battle. A fight that came close to the eastern capital is almost nameless in the official histories.
result: 結局明確而簡短：起義失敗。隋書《煬帝紀》記「冬十月丁丑，賊帥呂明星率眾數千圍東郡，武賲郎將費青奴擊斬之」，明星本人死於官軍之手；通鑑卷一百八十二則作「賊帥呂明星圍東郡，虎賁郎將費青奴擊破之」，只說破眾，不提斬首。兩書一致的部分是：圍解，東郡城未陷，數千起義眾潰散。史書沒有留下收編、降眾與戰損的數字，因此人數的下落只能記為不明。事件之後，隋廷在八日內下詔改博陵郡為高陽郡，赦該境內死罪已下、給復一年，把河北巡幸地與叛亂治理同時並進；同年底楊玄感一案以車裂、焚揚收結，鎮壓的力度只增不減。呂明星本人沒有留下任何記載，連籍貫與首義地都無從考證；對隋朝整體而言，這只是密集起義中的一環，既未釀成王朝危機，也未動搖其統治，直到五年後隋室才在瓦崗軍與李密的攻擊下崩解。可以確定的只有：一名被正史稱為「賊帥」的地方首領，率數千人逼近洛陽，又在同年十月被一支精騎打散。
resultEn: The outcome is plain and short: the rising failed. The Book of Sui, Annals of Yangdi, records: in the tenth month, on the dingchou day, the rebel commander Lü Mingbao led several thousand men to surround Dong Commandery, and the wubei langjiang Fei Qingnu struck him down. Lü Mingbao himself died in the hands of the government force. The Comprehensive Mirror, juan 182, writes it differently: the rebel commander Lü Mingbao surrounded Dong Commandery, and the tiger guard langjiang Fei Qingnu broke him; it speaks only of breaking the rebels and not of the beheading. What the two texts share is this: the siege was lifted, the city of Dong Commandery did not fall, and the several thousand rebels scattered. The histories preserve no figures for the number of men taken on parole, for those who surrendered, or for losses, so the fate of the force can only be recorded as unknown. After the event the Sui court, within eight days, issued an edict renaming Boling Commandery as Gaoyang, pardoning all crimes punishable by death within that territory and granting a year's remission, thereby advancing the pacification of the tour route in Hebei and the policing of the rebellion at the same time; at the end of that same year the case of Yang Xuangan was closed with the wheel and the burning of bodies, and the force of repression grew rather than slackened. Lü Mingbao himself left behind no record of any kind, and neither his origin nor the place of his first rising can be traced. For the Sui as a whole this was one link in a dense chain of risings: it created no dynastic crisis and shook no established authority, and the Sui house only fell five years later under the attack of the Wagang army and Li Mi. Only this can be stated with certainty: a local leader whom the official histories call a rebel commander came with several thousand men close to Luoyang, and in the same October was scattered by a single body of elite cavalry.
